describe: The image shows four blurred dark figures standing side by side, seen from the front, on a flat mid-grey transparent background. Each figure is a dark olive-black silhouette with a darker head and shoulders, the leftmost two faint and the rightmost two somewhat sharper. A small patch of muted yellow-ochre sits above the centre pair, the only warm colour in the image. The lighting is soft and even with no strong highlights. Transparent background.
